verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a way to register outbound HTTP callbacks that notify a programmatic consumer of Customer.io events. The only mention of webhooks (customer-io-docs-43) lists them as a message channel for automated sends, which is an adjacent feature, not event subscription. Data-out integrations (customer-io-docs-29) send data to third-party platforms but are not shown to be registrable event webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
